packs.name: Vampires
packs.summary: Sims can become vampires who rank up from Fledgling to Grand Master, choosing powers (like turning into a bat or mist, mesmerizing others, or resisting the sun) and taking on weaknesses as they grow stronger. Vampires can follow the Good Vampire or Master Vampire aspiration and learn Vampire Lore and the Pipe Organ. Comes with Forgotten Hollow, a gloomy world where it's never quite day, home to the ancient Count Vladislaus Straud and the Vatore siblings.

packs.name: Realm of Magic
packs.summary: Sims can become spellcasters who rank up from Apprentice through Acolyte and Adept to Virtuoso, learning spells from three schools of magic (Practical, Untamed, and Mischief), brewing potions at a cauldron, bonding with a familiar, and dueling other spellcasters. Overusing magic, losing duels, or failed potions can bring curses. Spellcasters can pass on the gift of magic, and the Purveyor of Potions aspiration is all about brewing. Comes with Glimmerbrook, a misty storybook village, and the hidden Magic Realm where the Sages run Magic HQ.

packs.name: Paranormal Stuff
packs.summary: Haunted houses full of specters (playful, mischievous, grumpy, and mopey ones) and accursed objects, a Medium skill for holding séances, and Guidry, a flirty ghost paranormal investigator who visits at night and can license Sims to take ghost-busting gigs. You can summon Bonehilda, a skeleton maid, collect specters in jars, and even get an invitation to join the Soul Reaper Society.

packs.name: Get to Work
packs.summary: Three active careers you follow your Sim to work in: Detective (crime scenes, clues, interrogations, arrests, up to Chief), Doctor (diagnoses, surgery, house calls, outbreaks, up to Chief of Staff), and Scientist (inventions like the SimRay and a cloning machine, serums, and a wormhole generator to the alien world). Sims can buy and run their own retail store and learn Baking and Photography. And aliens: abductions, aliens living in disguise, alien pregnancies (for any gender), and Sixam, the strange glowing alien world.
